name: Mashup Share
description: Upload your own song mashup for any level and replace its music. Everyone can upload one per level, and anyone can pick which one to play.

enabled.name: Enable Mashups
enabled.description: Play the selected mashup instead of the level's original song.

server-url.name: Server URL
server-url.description: URL of the Mashup Share server (see the <cy>server/</c> folder). No trailing slash.
